"I'll Never Fall in Love Again" is a song written by Lonnie Donegan and Jimmy Currie, and first released by Donegan as a single in 1962.

sections.heading: Composition
sections.wikitext: The verses are melodically based on the traditional folk song "Wanderin", even recycling the "It looks like" phrase. The Italian-styled chorus, however, sounds very different.<ref name="secondhandsongs.com"/>
sections.text: The verses are melodically based on the traditional folk song "Wanderin", even recycling the "It looks like" phrase. The Italian-styled chorus, however, sounds very different.

Upon its first release, Jones' recording reached number 2 on the UK Singles Chart but was less successful in the United States where it peaked at number 49 on the Hot 100, and number 28 on the Adult Contemporary chart. As the follow-up to Jones' "Love Me Tonight", "I'll Never Fall in Love Again" was reissued in 1969 in the US, reaching number six on the Hot 100 and number one on the Adult Contemporary chart.

sections.heading: Certifications
Other versions
sections.wikitext:
In 1968, "Plus jamais", a French version of the song was recorded by the Belgian singer [[Liliane Saint-Pierre]]. The song reached No. 44 on the [[Ultratop]] chart in Belgium.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.ultratop.be/fr/song/942fb/Liliane-Saint-Pierre-Plus-jamais | title=Liliane Saint-Pierre - Plus jamais - ultratop.be | website=[[Ultratop]] }}</ref>

It was also recorded by [[Timi Yuro]] on her 1968 album ''Something Bad on My Mind'', [[Lena Martell]], Charlie Hodges,<ref>Discogs - [https://www.discogs.com/Charlie-Hodges-Ill-Never-Fall-In-Love-Again/release/8323138 Charlie Hodges – I'll Never Fall In Love Again ]</ref> [[Richard Marx]] (B-side to "The Way She Loves Me"), and Marco T.{{Citation needed|date=September 2018}}

Jones' version was covered in 1978 by Filipino Tom Jones impersonator [[Sam Sorono]] on his ''Sings Tom Jones' Greatest Hits'' album on [[EMI Records]].<ref>Discogs - [https://www.discogs.com/Sam-Sorono-Sing-Tom-Jones-Greatest-Hits/release/4986608 Sam Sorono – Sing Tom Jones' Greatest Hits]</ref>

The song was also covered by [[Elvis Presley]] on the album ''[[From Elvis Presley Boulevard, Memphis, Tennessee]]'' in 1976.

In 2019, Donegan's son, Peter auditioned for ''[[The Voice UK]]'' in which Tom Jones turned his chair for him. Jones, when finding out and taken aback by who he was, performed an impromptu duet of the song with Peter.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/reality-tv/a25758564/the-voice-uk-judge-sir-tom-jones-lonnie-donegan-peter-ill-never-fall-in-love-again/|title=The Voice UK judge fights back tears as friend's son performs|first=Dan|last=Seddon|date=5 January 2019|website=Digital Spy}}</ref>
sections.text:
In 1968, "Plus jamais", a French version of the song was recorded by the Belgian singer Liliane Saint-Pierre. The song reached No. 44 on the Ultratop chart in Belgium.

It was also recorded by Timi Yuro on her 1968 album Something Bad on My Mind, Lena Martell, Charlie Hodges, Richard Marx (B-side to "The Way She Loves Me"), and Marco T.{{Citation needed|date=September 2018}}

Jones' version was covered in 1978 by Filipino Tom Jones impersonator Sam Sorono on his Sings Tom Jones' Greatest Hits album on EMI Records.

The song was also covered by Elvis Presley on the album From Elvis Presley Boulevard, Memphis, Tennessee in 1976.

In 2019, Donegan's son, Peter auditioned for The Voice UK in which Tom Jones turned his chair for him. Jones, when finding out and taken aback by who he was, performed an impromptu duet of the song with Peter.
